scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @seo/web" "npm run dev -w @seo/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @seo/shared && npm run build -w @seo/rules && npm run build -w @seo/db
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @seo/db && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @seo/web && npm run build -w @seo/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/rules/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json
